title: Golden Olive Oil Focaccia with Flaky Sea Salt
summary: A same-day wet dough is strengthened with four sets of folds instead of kneading, risen in an oiled tin, dimpled deeply and baked hot with olive oil and flaky sea salt.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast and fine salt together, add the water and 2 tbsp oil and mix 1-2 minutes to a sticky dough with no dry flour. Cover and rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: With a wet hand, stretch one side of the dough up and fold it over the middle; turn the bowl and repeat 4 times. Repeat these folds 3 more times, every 30 minutes, until the dough is smooth and bubbly.

steps.title: Rise in the tin
steps.text: Pour 2 tbsp oil into the tin, add the dough, turn to coat and stretch towards the corners. Cover and leave 1 hour until puffy, stretching into the corners again halfway.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C (210 °C fan) with a shelf in the lower third.

steps.title: Dimple
steps.text: Drizzle with the last 1 tbsp oil, press oiled fingers firmly to the bottom of the tin all over, then scatter with flaky salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 22-26 minutes until deep golden on top and underneath. Cool on a rack at least 20 minutes before cutting.

tips: Wet hands stop the sticky dough clinging to you during folding.
Press the dimples right to the base or they will spring back in the oven.
A metal tin gives a crisper, more golden base than glass or ceramic.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature and eat within 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Refresh in a hot oven for a few minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
